data.name: Madan
data.long_meaning: Madan is a Sanskrit name, derived from the word 'mada' meaning intoxication or infatuation. In Hindu mythology, Madan is the god of love and desire, often depicted as riding on a chariot pulled by white horses. He is also known as Manmadh or Kamadeva.
